scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic for every number of leaves. Exact-rational finite checks supplement but do not substitute for the proof. No publication priority, independent validation, or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only unit-edge counting-measure finite stars, uncentered metric graph-ball averages, and total edge variation; not arbitrary weighted graphs, general trees, other ball families, or higher p-variation. A plausible 2021 finite-graph paper was not inspected in full; priority remains unverified.
title: Sharp total variation amplification for uncentered maximal averages on finite star graphs
